name: Projected Maximum Positive Degree / VC Dimension
details: A shattered set projects to a full cube, whose top vertex has one smaller neighbour in every cube coordinate.
witness_verification: For every n >= 4, Singleton-Cosingleton has VC 3 (value 1127) and positive projected RTD n-1 (value 1129). Survey Proposition prop:positive-projection-collapse identifies projected maximum positive degree with positive projected RTD. Thus the endpoint ratio is (n-1)/3 and is unbounded. The former finite witness {001,010,111}, with values 2 versus 1, remains valid and its class/value records are retained. The universal proof, not the bounded regression in sync/verify_singleton_cosingleton.py, proves divergence.
proof: Let S be shattered with |S|=d. Then $\mathcal H_{|S}$ is the full d-cube, whose top vertex has d smaller one-coordinate neighbours. Hence $\mathrm d^{+p}_{\max}(\mathcal H)\ge d$; maximize over shattered S.
